<parameter name="content"># atlas

Monorepo with three services:

- `api/` — Go, gRPC
- `web/` — React/TypeScript
- `pipeline/` — Python, Airflow

Each service has its own `CLAUDE.md` with service-specific commands and gotchas. Read it before working in that directory.

## Conventions (all services)

- Commit messages follow Conventional Commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `chore:`, ...).
- `make check` must pass before opening any PR.
- Trunk-based development: branch off `main`, keep branches short-lived, merge quickly. No long-lived branches.

## Pointers

- Incident response: use the `incident-response` skill; do not improvise the steps.
- Product metrics / warehouse questions: use the `warehouse` MCP server (read-only).

<parameter name="content"># Claude Code context layout for atlas

Principle: always-loaded context (CLAUDE.md) holds only short facts needed in most sessions; long procedures load on demand (skills); external systems go through MCP; things that must never happen are enforced by hooks/permissions, not prose.

## Files and mechanisms

| Location | Mechanism | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| `CLAUDE.md` (root) | Always-loaded memory | Org-wide conventions (conventional commits, `make check`, trunk-based) apply to every session in every service. |
| `api/CLAUDE.md` | Directory-scoped memory (loads when working under `api/`) | Go/gRPC notes and the `api/gen/` generated-code warning only matter in `api/`. |
| `web/CLAUDE.md` | Directory-scoped memory | The `npm test` (Playwright, real browsers) vs `npm run test:unit` distinction only matters in `web/`. |
| `pipeline/CLAUDE.md` | Directory-scoped memory | The `AIRFLOW_HOME=pipeline/.airflow` requirement only matters in `pipeline/`. |
| `.claude/settings.json` hook (PreToolUse on Edit/Write matching `api/gen/**`) | Hook | The "hand-edits silently overwritten" failure is silent, so block it deterministically and tell Claude to edit the `.proto` and run `make proto`. CLAUDE.md alone is advisory. |
| `.claude/skills/incident-response/SKILL.md` | Skill (on-demand) | A 20-step runbook is too long to pay for in every session; a skill loads only when an incident comes up. Keep it identical across teams. |
| `.mcp.json` (`warehouse` server) | MCP server | Live SQL against the analytics warehouse needs a real tool connection, not instructions. Use a read-only role. |
| `.claude/settings.json` permissions | Permissions | Allow the warehouse query tool, deny write/DDL tools, so analysts get queries without prompts and without risk. |

## Notes

- **Runbook sharing:** since every team in the company uses the same runbook, ideally publish it once as a plugin (or in a shared repo) that atlas and other repos install, rather than copying it into each repo where it will drift. Keeping it in `.claude/skills/` here is the fallback.
- **Org-wide conventions:** if you want them enforced beyond atlas, they can also live in a managed (org-level) CLAUDE.md. The root file is enough for this repo.
- **Warehouse credentials:** never commit them. Reference environment variables in `.mcp.json` and have each analyst supply their own read-only credentials locally.
- **AIRFLOW_HOME:** stated in `pipeline/CLAUDE.md`. If it keeps being forgotten, add it to a `make` target wrapper rather than more prose.
- **Keep CLAUDE.md files short.** Anything over a screen or so, or only relevant to one task type, should become a skill.
